title: Plasma Orb Monsters
description: A glowing glass plasma globe sits on a wooden surface, containing several cartoonish neon-colored monsters connected by electrical arcs to a central pink core. Bright pink, green, and yellow light reflects onto the table below against a dramatic red and green background.
prompt: A surreal digital painting of a large glass plasma orb on a wooden table, containing multiple cartoon monsters in bright neon green, pink and purple. One large plant-like monster and a green robot-like creature with yellow eyes are connected by blue and pink electrical arcs to a glowing central orb. Smaller monsters float nearby. Dramatic red and green background with vibrant light reflections and splashes on the table surface.
